body: Phase 10d of PLAN.md, phase H4 of docs/headless-cli-plan.md. Bare `sati` shows a status and a menu to a person at a terminal (help with exit 2 otherwise, as today). `sati activity --follow`. `sati task list --board`. Budgets: home under 300 ms on the 5,000-task fixture; --follow idle under 1% of one core.

completion.releaseNote: Bare `sati` shows a status and a menu; `sati task list --board` and `sati activity --follow` are new.
completion.summary: H4: a bare `sati` shows a person at a terminal a status (needs you, in progress, ready) and a menu that runs the common commands as child processes; agents, pipes, --no-input and non-projects still get help with exit 2. `task list --board` prints the board's columns (side by side, stacked, plain, or grouped JSON). `activity --follow` prints new rows as they are written by polling data_version every 250 ms; SIGINT exits 0. Bench gained two budgets: home on 5,000 tasks 195 ms (budget 300), follow idle under 0.2% of a core (budget 1%). 12 new tests; gate and 97 Playwright tests pass. Found, not fixed: inbox reads every task and note (275 ms on 50,000 records), noted in docs/ideas.md.

title: H4: home screen for bare sati, activity --follow, task list --board
